[Kirkk] The iPad Air 2 was originally released in October 2014, making the model line 12 years old.
Key milestones and limitations for this specific device:
Hardware Release: While the iPad Air 2 launched in October 2014, the 32GB configuration was introduced later in September 2016 (replacing the base 16GB tier) and discontinued in March 2017. That makes this specific manufacturing tier roughly 9.5 to 10 years old.
Software Support: Apple dropped major iPadOS support for the iPad Air 2 with iPadOS 16 in late 2022. Its operating system caps out at iPadOS 15.
App Compatibility: Because it cannot update past iPadOS 15, many modern apps from the App Store (banking apps, streaming platforms, newer games, and productivity tools) will either refuse to install or no longer receive updates.
Storage: A 32GB capacity leaves roughly 18–22GB of usable space after the operating system and system files are accounted for.
At $115 including a $39 SIM voucher, it can still function as a basic web browser, dedicated media player, or digital photo display, but it is effectively obsolete for mainstream app usage and modern multitasking.
